title: The Big 50 club photograph and members of Fisher's band
summary: Hazel explains where the picture of Fisher's band came from, how drummer Swift drowned, who was in the band, and Fisher's real name.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
